construction.note: The generator and credits identify Sandy Kurt’s Tomb of Itimud ad-Daula PDF. The current sequence uses its squares and small-circle construction, regrouped into nine app steps.
construction.changes: The saved PDF was read and selected drawings compared during this audit, but a complete comparison of every current step, ink segment and repeat is not established. Earlier exact monument-match claims were rejected; that does not by itself show whether the PDF was followed accurately.

credits.source: 4fold Pattern from the Tomb of Itimud ad-Daula
credits.creator: Sandy Kurt (sandykurt.com)
credits.note: Circle divided into eight parts, static and dynamic squares establishing small circles and lines for octagons and stars.

photos.caption: Cropped panel of marble and stone inlay work on the exterior wall of the Tomb of I'timād-ud-Daulah, Agra. Historical reference; this construction has not been verified against this panel.
photos.creator: Sabyasachi Paldas

verification.note: Mughal star-and-octagon study after Sandy Kurt’s construction. Its match to the Tomb of I’timād-ud-Daulah panel has not been verified; the photograph is a historical reference.

given.A: Any point to the right of O. The distance OA is the radius, and the unit for every length.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O through A.
Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at E, N, W and S. These letters stand for east, north, west and south.

Draw the line through O that halves the angle at O between E and N. Draw the line through O that halves the angle at O between N and W. These lines cross the circle at NE, NW, SW and SE. The circle is now cut into eight equal parts.
Join E, N, W and S with straight lines. This square stands on its corner. Its sides cross the lines through NE and NW at M1, M2, M3 and M4.

Draw a straight line through M2 and M1. Draw a straight line through M3 and M4. Draw a straight line through M4 and M1. Draw a straight line through M3 and M2. These lines make a square that sits flat. They cross the horizontal and vertical lines halfway out, at jE, jN, jW and jS.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a straight line through M4 and M1. It crosses the horizontal line at jE, halfway out. The points jN, jW and jS are halfway out on the other sides.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O through jE. Draw a circle with centre E, the same size. Draw a circle with centre N, the same size. Draw a circle with centre W, the same size. Draw a circle with centre S, the same size.

Draw a straight line through K2 and K1. Draw a straight line through K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through K4 and K1. Draw a straight line through K3 and K2. K1 to K4 are where the small circle at O crosses the lines through NE and NW. These lines make a square inside the small circle.
Draw a straight line through jN and jE. Draw a straight line through jN and jW. Draw a straight line through jS and jW. Draw a straight line through jS and jE.

Draw a straight line through U3 and U2. Draw a straight line through U6 and U7. Draw a straight line through U1 and U8. Draw a straight line through U4 and U5. These points are where the sides of the small square cross the circles at N, S, E and W.

ink.text: Ink the eight-pointed star at the centre. Ink the octagons round it and the squares at the corners.

parts.text: Ink the star at O. Its points are jE, jN, jW and jS, and the corners K1 to K4 of the small square.
Ink the octagon at N, along the line through U3 and U2. Ink the octagon at S, along the line through U6 and U7.
Ink the octagon at E, along the line through U1 and U8. Ink the octagon at W, along the line through U4 and U5.

pattern.text: Put copies of the standing square tile side by side. Eight-pointed stars and corner squares fit together with regular octagons between them.
